name: Ninomiya Makoto
source:
Hobbies: Astronomical Observation, Observing People
Favorite Food: Musk Melon
Least Favorite Food: Soybeans
Favorite Animal: Owls
Least Favorite Animal: Cockroaches
Favorite Motto: The current situation is restoration-specific and meaningless.

Third year high school student, the student council vice-president.
The heir to the extremely wealthy 'Ninomiya Zaibatsu'.
